free_tier_limits.correction: Developer plan: 2,000 requests/day and 3 requests/second. DeFi Positions, Wallet Portfolio Chart, and Wallet P&L endpoints are limited to 25% of the plan quota.

rate_limits.correction: Rate limits are published and plan-dependent. The Developer plan allows 2,000 requests/day at 3 RPS; Zerion also publishes quota and RPS limits for paid plans and returns rate-limit headers with API responses.

notes: The API and v1 wallet endpoints remain documented and operational. The principal error is authentication syntax: API-key requests use HTTP Basic authentication, not Bearer. Zerion also now supports optional x402 and MPP pay-per-request authentication.
